'''August 2000 Austin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Juniors Cards and Comics, Austin, TX on 19 August 2000. [[Jacob Mayer]] won it. It is known from Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1157">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-23-austin-tx-8-19-sm-report-dsii-discussiond1157/ austin-tx-8-19-sm-report-dsii-discussion], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 23 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-23-austin-tx-8-19-sm-report-dsii-discussiond1157/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Juniors Cards and Comics, Austin, TX
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 21
* '''Winner:''' [[Jacob Mayer]]
